title: Creatinine–urea nonadditivity provides no clear incremental cross-sample grip prediction
abstract: In adults aged≥40, a centered log-creatinine × log-BUN term beyond flexible additive renal/body-size measures gave NHANES2011–12→2013–14 weighted grip-strength MSE improvement 0.042858 kg² (95% joint PSU-bootstrap interval -0.365995 to 0.206033); this does not establish incremental predictive value.
